cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.14)
project(flutter LANGUAGES CXX)

# This value is used when generating builds using the Flutter tool.
set(FLUTTER_MANAGED_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ephemeral")

# Flutter configuration is provided through a script generated by the Flutter tool.
include(${FLUTTER_MANAGED_DIR}/generated_config.cmake OPTIONAL)

set(FLUTTER_EPHEMERAL_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ephemeral")

# Published to parent scope for runner
set(FLUTTER_TARGET_PLATFORM "windows-x64" PARENT_SCOPE)

add_library(flutter_wrapper_plugin INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(flutter_wrapper_plugin INTERFACE
  "${FLUTTER_EPHEMERAL_DIR}/cpp_client_wrapper/include"
)

add_library(flutter_wrapper_app INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(flutter_wrapper_app INTERFACE
  "${FLUTTER_EPHEMERAL_DIR}/cpp_client_wrapper/include"
)
